g.text: One checked meaning. Python reference execution first; verified hardware planning follows.
Proposed design • 3 October 2026 • Compiler and hardware paths are not yet implemented.
Host Python prepares data and calls the public API.
Captured kernels are read as source, never executed to discover the program.
Python owns types, numeric rules, memory, effects and legality.
xDSL is an optional backend adapter, not a core dependency.
ZOOM IN / interfaces, ownership and verification boundaries
A complete proposed Lab 1 kernel • fixed Spatial prelude
SourceUnit + CaptureBundle: exact text, module IDs, dependencies, prelude.
source/ retains tokens and source spans; decorators and bodies never run.
Immutable semantic root + exact revision identity
Public queries never expose a mutable graph
Explicit captures, control structure and ordered effects
Storage identity, shapes, capabilities and lifetime rules
Origins are linked by IDs; provenance is separately hashed
Proposed record schema • closed tags and payloads • no host callbacks
Revision-scoped side tables, outside semantic nodes
RecordIndex: node, parent, value users, callers
analysis/ caches facts; runtime/ derives ExecutionProgram
Each cache binds the exact revision and applicable versions.
Mutable execution state belongs to one Invocation (03).
passes/ edits a candidate, then rechecks before publication
Fresh owned IDs; preserve borrowed backing identity.
Remap captures/results/tokens; transfer origins and requirements.
Rebuild indices; stale facts and execution caches cannot carry over.
backing snapshots, frames, requests, queues, RNG.
Copy each backing once; preserve shared views.
Proposed host API for tiled output. Completed alone publishes outputs.
Fault → inspect diagnostics/prefix. Waiting or budget stop → resumable state.
RunResult also records traces and run identity; full outcome union in [B].
Same CheckedProgram + target + binding_contract → plan(...) checks
S6: execute plan records in Python
Only for a measured backend benefit
Failed / Unknown required target obligations block emission.
Reference validity ≠ target eligibility; hardware evidence is separate.
05 / SHARED RULES, OWNERSHIP AND REPRODUCIBLE EVIDENCE
Frozen descriptors and registered operation profiles.
Int is signed 32-bit wrapping; Index is an exact coordinate.
Numeric handlers own rounding, overflow, bits and casts.
check/ and runtime/ share rules; target realizations preserve them.
Pure request/commit transitions over explicit resource state.
Views share owners; aliases never create fresh storage.
Allocation site + activation path + generation distinguish state.
Ordered queue transfer: one item at a time; retain committed prefixes
Canonical data-only artifacts; imports re-enter verification.
Separate semantic, provenance, plan, build and run identities.
Diagnostic: code + phase + source span + related locations.
Independent expected bits, state traces, failures and boundary cases.
A candidate and its own helper cannot certify one another.
Record requested / synthesized / measured hardware results separately.
06 / BUILD THROUGH EE109 PATTERNS — EXTEND THE SAME COMPILER
Compare every output; diagnose invalid inputs.
Vary shapes, helpers and alias relationships.
Queue order, selected branches, consume counts.
Identity differs from fold seed and reset.
Values and state traces must both agree.
Runtime extents, tails, initial C, aliases.
Row publication, shift direction, reset and warm-up.
Keep current-guide and older-fixture profiles separate.
Check signed gradients as well as final magnitudes.
Source/builder/import agreement; independent values/effects; small rewrite with remapping, rollback and stale-cache tests.
REP-S6(scope), checked plans, plan execution, generated HLS + vendor evidence.
May start for the accepted S1 family while later language patterns grow.
The lab subset does not require all S3 floating/math profiles or S5 communicating tasks first. Full rewrite scope remains in the roadmap.
Every capability needs source, checks, execution, diagnostics and independent fixtures. Research probes are not implementation evidence.
READING KEY / Blue: owned meaning · Orange: source / first milestone · Green: reference path / results · Amber: verification
Dashed: later or optional path. All components are proposed. Colors do not indicate implementation completion. Source labels below are clickable.
